available < 0 {\n\t\tavailable = 0\n\t}\n\n\treturn map[string]any{\n\t\t\"campaign_id\":               campaignID,\n\t\t\"party_items\":               partyItems,\n\t\t\"assigned_items\":            assignedItems,\n\t\t\"healing_potions_available\": available,\n\t}, nil\n}\n\n// --- crafting project DB helpers ---\n\nfunc dbCreateCraftingProject(p *craftingProject) error {\n\t_, err := := dbGetCraftingProjectTx(tx, projectID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tif p == nil {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\n\tif p.Status != \"active\" {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"project
